snapshot.agent_notes: Read-only public gateway. No account, authentication, login, API key, token, password, passkey, payment, credentials, or 2FA is required. Full category coverage pages live at the linked Packrift Merchant Category Coverage Atlas. This is not a live price source, live inventory promise, checkout quote, delivery promise, freight quote, freight promise, supplier-cost disclosure, margin report, customer/order/cart/payment system, private source path, private feed export, private freight source, or credential source.
snapshot.description: A compact no-auth Packrift gateway for public merchant category coverage, families, product types, feed statuses, dimension-source statuses, band rollups, and links into the full Merchant Category Coverage Atlas.
